name: AdventureLog
short_desc: Self-hostable travel tracker and trip planner with interactive maps and itineraries
author: Sean Morley
description: AdventureLog is a modern open-source travel companion. Pin every place you've visited, build multi-day trip itineraries, mark countries and regions on an interactive world map, and collaborate with the people you travel with. Features locations & visits with photos/categories, interactive 2D/3D maps, trip planning with itineraries/checklists, world travel book with countries/regions/cities stats, trails & activities with GPX tracks, full-text search, MFA, social auth (Google, GitHub, Authelia), and integrations with Immich, Strava, Endurain, Wanderer, and Google Maps. Built with Django, SvelteKit, PostGIS, and Tailwind CSS.
